extra.final_summary:
Average body mass by sex (after cleaning): female ≈ 4,038 g, male ≈ 4,963 g (52 rows used).

Data problems found and fixed:
- body_mass_g was stored as text with two values using thousands separators ("4,350", "5,350"); converted the column to numbers.
- 2 exact duplicate rows (7, 11) removed so no penguin was double-counted.
- 3 rows (1, 4, 12) had body_mass_g of 3,150,000–3,800,000 g, far outside the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g (likely unit errors); excluded with approval.

Noted but not fixed (not needed for this question): island has whitespace variants ("Biscoe ", " Biscoe"), and row 21 has a negative flipper_length_mm (-187, outside the 170–235 range). The sex column was clean and matched the allowed labels.
